data.name: HerSalon
data.detailed_description:
Every appointment is more than a makeover; it’s a conversation, a moment of care, and a step toward healing.

Play as Melody, an ambitious woman who's left the corporate world behind to open a small hair salon in a divided town.

Listen closely to your customers’ stories, choose styles that match their needs, and watch how being heard can change a community.

A cozy, slice-of-life management game with a strong narrative heart, Her Salon blends relaxing salon gameplay with heartfelt storytelling about burnout, community, and finding yourself.

Key features:

  • Meaningful styling choices: match hairstyles to each customer’s unique desires and demands.

  • Narrative Branching: choose dialogue and hairstyles that can change character arcs and shape your community.

  • End-of-day progression: review your earnings, restock supplies, and shape your salon’s reputation over time.

  • Warm, intimate presentation: a first-person, “in the chair” perspective inspired by cozy favorites.

If you love cozy narrative games, character-driven stories, and satisfying management loops, wishlist HerSalon and start your fresh chapter.

Great for Tavern Talk, Good Pizza, Great Pizza, and Venba fans.
